cues.narration: A potent structural lead arrives with mutagenicity, clearance, and stereochemical liabilities.
cues.title: Start with (S)-x1

cues.narration: The study reports three distinct strategies rather than one retrospective success path.
cues.title: Three parallel ideas

cues.narration: Electron-withdrawing substitutions reduce activity and this branch is not progressed.
cues.title: 6-position substitutions stop

cues.narration: Most heterocycles lose potency; the exception retains a re-aromatization risk.
cues.title: Heterocycle replacement stops

cues.narration: A six-membered lactam displaces the ligand and is retained as a negative decision.
cues.title: Ring expansion stops

cues.narration: The spiro lactam preserves activity while addressing the Ames and racemization hypotheses.
cues.title: Spiro lactam progresses

cues.narration: Multi-parameter optimization produces the structurally confirmed preclinical candidate.
cues.title: DNDI-6510 selected

cues.narration: The durable record keeps the later PXR-linked repeat-dose exposure failure beside the successful lead selection.
cues.title: The program still stops
